cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I Changed the Odds
cards.instruction: Hide how your own choice tilted the contest, bargain, or consequence while continuing to judge the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. A fair result. Let's celebrate my cake's first prize. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why did you move yours under the judging light?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Lighting maintenance. We shouldn't let logistics overshadow flavour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine was left in the shade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. A useful note for whoever organises next year's logistics.

mechanism: A offers better display for B cake while separating that concession from the judging result A own lighting choice tilted.
confusable: Unlike an innocent logistics error, B explicitly identifies A moved their own cake into judging light before A defends the award.
comparison: A post-judging display correction differs from a raffle participant offering next draw control.
seedUse: D205-a judging light and shade; S02-a supplies visibility now while protecting A earlier result.
